title: SN TOOL STUDIO PRO - Official Update v1.1.9 (Bulletproof Downloader Engine & Same-Drive Zero-Freeze Pro)
subtitle: A major update (v1.1.9) is available with Same-Drive Isolated Temp, 95% Remux Zero-Freeze Guarantee, and Resilient Folder Auto-Recovery.
release_notes:
• 🛡️ Bulletproof High-Speed Downloader Engine: Integrated Same-Drive Isolated Temp architecture that completely bypasses Disk C consumption during downloads, preventing 'No space left on device' failures across all client machines!
• ⚡ 95% Remux Zero-Freeze Guarantee: Transitioned from cross-drive file copies to instant 0.001-second atomic volume moves (os.replace) with multi-attempt Windows Defender lock recovery, eliminating stalls at 95%!
• 📁 Resilient Drive & Folder Auto-Recovery: Smart fallback that dynamically verifies write permissions and available free space, seamlessly defaulting to safe user Downloads/Videos if Drive D is missing or read-only!
• 🔄 Multi-Tier Fallback Stream Engine: Added automatic chunked stream fallback when HLS m3u8 playlists encounter network timeouts or CDN restrictions.
• 🚀 Continuous Performance & Stability Improvements.
